title: HTTP designer health (1.2)
description: The body of GET /health on an HTTP-bound designer's origin -- design/designer-interface.md §7.1, "Arrays by reference". Required from a designer that accepts arrays by reference; the caller reads it once, before its first request by reference, and sends none if it does not match.

contract_version.description: the highest contract version the designer implements, e.g. "1.2"

shared_root.description: true when the designer is configured with a shared root, so it can honour an array sent by reference

parallel.description: optional: how many designs the designer runs at once; a caller sends it no more than this (§7.2). Absent means 1.

design_version.description: 1.4, optional: the designer's design version, bumped by any change that can alter an answer to the same request (beyond a small tolerance); 0 means before versioning. design/design-version.md.

design_settings.description: 1.4, optional: an opaque digest, equal between two designers exactly when their non-default settings that can alter an answer are equal.

designer_build.description: 1.4, optional: the designer's build, for people; a caller keys nothing on it.

designer_release.description: 1.5, optional: the release the designer is, as its version (e.g. 0.2.10), for people; a caller keys nothing on it.

design_settings_detail.description: 1.4, optional: the settings design_settings digests, by name, for a person to see why two designers disagree; never a key.

adjustment_kinds.description: 1.5, optional and advisory: the adjustment kinds this designer knows (design/designer-interface.md §2 and §7.1), by kind. A caller builds its choices from it; a kind not listed may still be sent and is answered not_understood.
